title: CmdPal: Fix settings search result layout in a wide window

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The final layout concerns do not establish a required change. WinUI centers a Stretch-aligned element constrained by MaxWidth when space remains; the proposed left-alignment failure does not follow from these settings. The existing Appearance and Extensions settings pages also use the same 16-pixel padding pattern, so changing only this page to 24 pixels would be a preference rather than a demonstrated fix.

**Validation scope:** The retained exact-head XML/source checks and WinUI alignment implementation were reviewed. No interactive layout run or new product build is claimed. No code change is requested by this qualified assessment; it is not an unconditional approval.
